number_sense.name: Number sense & estimation
number_sense.description: Intuition for quantities, magnitudes, and reasonableness of answers

operations_fluency.name: Operations fluency
operations_fluency.description: Mental and written +, -, ×, ÷ with whole numbers and simple decimals

decimals.name: Decimal operations
decimals.description: Multiplying, dividing, comparing decimals. Understanding place value past the decimal point.

fractions_operations.name: Fraction operations
fractions_operations.description: Adding, subtracting, multiplying fractions. Finding common denominators.

fractions_as_reasoning.name: Fractions as reasoning tools
fractions_as_reasoning.description: Using fractions to make decisions, compare quantities, reason about parts of wholes in context — not just computing.

estimation.name: Estimation & reasonableness
estimation.description: Ballpark answers before calculating. Checking if an answer makes sense.

proportional_direct.name: Direct proportional reasoning
proportional_direct.description: If X doubles, Y doubles. Scaling up. Unit rates.

proportional_inverse.name: Inverse proportional reasoning
proportional_inverse.description: Given a total, work backward to find per-unit or per-group amounts.

rate_conversion.name: Rate & unit conversion
rate_conversion.description: Converting between rates (per minute, per hour), understanding speed/time/distance, events per time period.

percentages.name: Percentages
percentages.description: Percent as proportion. Finding percentages of quantities. Percent increase/decrease.

division_remainders.name: Division with remainders in context
division_remainders.description: Dividing and interpreting what the remainder means in real situations (round up? round down? fraction left over?).

negative_numbers.name: Negative numbers & integers
negative_numbers.description: Understanding, ordering, adding, and subtracting negative numbers. Number line reasoning.

variables_unknowns.name: Variables & unknowns
variables_unknowns.description: Using letters to represent unknown quantities. Solving simple one-step and two-step equations.

patterns_functions.name: Patterns & functions
patterns_functions.description: Identifying, extending, and describing numerical and visual patterns. Input-output rules.

decomposition.name: Problem decomposition
decomposition.description: Breaking a complex problem into smaller, manageable parts.

sequencing.name: Logical sequencing
sequencing.description: Ordering steps, using temporal markers (first, then, finally, after that).

causal_chains.name: Causal chain reasoning
causal_chains.description: If A then B, and if B then C. Tracking consequences through multiple steps.

justification_depth.name: Justification depth
justification_depth.description: Giving multiple reasons, not just one. Building layered arguments.

counterarguments.name: Counter-argument handling
counterarguments.description: Considering opposing views. Integrating or rebutting without shutting down.

metacognition.name: Metacognition
metacognition.description: Awareness of one's own thinking process. Ability to identify what's hard and why.

transfer_unfamiliar.name: Transfer to unfamiliar problems
transfer_unfamiliar.description: Applying known reasoning strategies to completely new problem types.

multi_constraint.name: Multi-constraint planning
multi_constraint.description: Solving problems where multiple constraints must be satisfied simultaneously.

connectors_en.name: Logical connectors (EN)
connectors_en.description: Using because, so, therefore, however, which means, since, given that, although, etc.

connectors_fr.name: Logical connectors (FR)
connectors_fr.description: Using parce que, donc, alors, cependant, ce qui veut dire, puisque, en revanche, etc.

sentence_complexity_en.name: Sentence complexity (EN)
sentence_complexity_en.description: Building compound and complex sentences. Subordinate clauses. Hypotheticals.

sentence_complexity_fr.name: Sentence complexity (FR)
sentence_complexity_fr.description: Moving beyond simple subject-verb-object. Using relative clauses, conditionals.

written_structure.name: Written structure
written_structure.description: Organizing ideas into clear sequence. Beginning-middle-end. Paragraph-level coherence.

fr_orthography.name: French orthography
fr_orthography.description: Spelling, conjugation, accents, agreement. Tracked patterns: verb endings, ne...pas, homophones.
known_errors: je nais pas → je n'ai pas

oral_fluency_fr.name: Oral fluency (FR)
oral_fluency_fr.description: Speaking French with reasonable fluency. Tracked via Deepgram: pause patterns, self-corrections, connector usage.
